Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Appointment of Certain Officers

On March 1, 2024, the Board of Directors of Example Holdings Corp. (the “Company”) appointed Jordan Avery as Chief Financial Officer, effective March 15, 2024.

Under the offer letter, Ms. Avery will receive an annual base salary of $450,000 and a target annual bonus equal to 60% of base salary.

There are no family relationships between Ms. Avery and any director or executive officer of the Company.
